_note: Chapter 10, edge of the Wide Rift: Mirela's burned words; she is the Warden from the inside (plan items 1442, 1443, 1463).

say: The Wide Rift hangs over the plain like a torn sky. No Warden stands here. Nobody holds it from this side.
The letters are fresh. Someone burned them into the rock from the other side of the Rift.
Mirela isn't lost. She's holding the Wide Rift. From the inside.
